purpose: Teach: 下北沢/築地/吉祥寺/バルサ/ヘッジファンド/スピリチュアル/おっぱい/ハイビジョン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、下北沢のライブハウスに通われてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: So this regular of yours goes to the live houses in Shimokitazawa…
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, drawing Aoi out. Warm but measured. Noticing something Aoi has observed. Soft, thoughtful pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、築地市場のお魚にお詳しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they're really knowledgeable about the fish at Tsukiji Market…
lines.style: Matching Mei's tone—reflective, almost cataloguing. Slight wonder in the voice. Sharing something small that charmed her. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、吉祥寺の井の頭公園がお気に入りだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Inokashira Park in Kichijoji is a favorite of theirs…
lines.style: Continuing the gentle thread. Building a picture. Soft attention on each detail. Unhurried, like arranging small treasures on a shelf.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、バルサの試合を生で観たいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They want to see Barcelona play live…
lines.style: A slight lift here—something more vivid. Still reflective but with a flicker of the customer's longing touching her voice. Tender recognition of a dream.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヘッジファンドのお仕事だって、メイちゃん
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not cold. Acknowledging the shape of their life—ordered, analytical. Quiet tone, slight pause before, like holding a fact gently.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スピリチュアルな本を読まれてるって、メイちゃん
lines.style: A small smile in the voice—the contradiction doesn't escape her. Not mocking. Curious about the contradiction. Slightly wondering tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、赤ちゃんがおっぱい飲むスピーチを聴いて感動されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They were moved by a speech about a baby nursing…
lines.style: Softer now. The tone shifts—something true underneath the surface. Quiet wonder at the tenderness of this person. Breath slightly fuller, like she's touched by what Aoi has noticed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ハイビジョンTVを買ったって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they just bought a high-definition television…
lines.style: Return to practical details but weighted with affection now. The simplicity of it—a small joy. Closing softly, almost like a secret held between them. Warmth in the ordinary.
